Title: HPV Vaccination
Label: HPV Vaccination
Subtitle: Percentage of teens ages 13 to 17 who completed the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination series.
MethodsNote: The number of adolescents ages 13 to 17 who completed the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination series are based on the number of HPV immunizations administered by 3/31/2017 and reported by 5/3/2017. The HPV vaccine series can be completed with 2 or 3 doses of HPV vaccine depending on the age at series initiation and interval between doses 1 and 2. An adolescent can complete the series with 2 doses if s/he begins the series prior to 15 years of age, and at least 5 months have elapsed between doses. Eleven percent of adolescents who completed the HPV series had an address that did not geocode to a community district and were excluded from community district level data (underestimating coverage). However, HPV Vaccination coverage for NYC includes all 13 to 17 adolescents living in NYC zip codes, regardless of geocoding to community district.
DenominatorSource: NYC DOHMH population estimates, modified from US Census Bureau interpolated intercensal population estimates, 2015, vintage 2016
